name: morning-brief
description: Build a personal morning brief: weather (reusing recipe 02 as a sub-workflow), top tech news, exchange rates and 'on this day' fetched in parallel, then written up by an LLM.

base_currency.description: Currency to quote exchange rates from

notify_channel.description: Optional OpenClaw channel for the brief (telegram, slack, discord, feishu...)

notify_target.description: Optional chat id / channel id for notify_channel

branches.run: curl -fsS --max-time 20 'https://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search?tags=front_page&hitsPerPage=6' | node -e 'const d = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")); console.log(JSON.stringify(d.hits.map(h => ({ title: h.title, url: h.url || "https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=" + h.objectID, points: h.points }))))' || echo '[]'

curl -fsS --max-time 20 "https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/$LOBSTER_ARG_BASE_CURRENCY" | node -e 'const d = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")); const out = {}; process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_CURRENCIES.split(",").map(c => c.trim().toUpperCase()).forEach(c => { if (d.rates[c]) out[c] = d.rates[c] }); console.log(JSON.stringify({ base: d.base_code, rates: out }))' || echo '{}'

curl -fsS --max-time 20 -H 'User-Agent: openclaw-cookbook (https://github.com/YalinMa/openclaw-cookbook)' "https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/feed/onthisday/selected/$(date +%m/%d)" | node -e 'const d = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")); console.log(JSON.stringify(d.selected.slice(0, 3).map(e => ({ year: e.year, text: e.text }))))' || echo '[]'

steps.run: node -e 'const s = JSON.parse(process.env.SOURCES); console.log(JSON.stringify({ date: new Date().toDateString(), weather: process.env.WEATHER.trim(), news: s.news || [], rates: s.rates || {}, onThisDay: s.history || [] }))'

steps.pipeline: llm.invoke --prompt 'Write a warm, upbeat morning brief for me from the facts below, under 160 words, in plain text with a few emoji. Sections: weather (with advice), 3 most interesting tech headlines (titles only, no URLs), exchange rates in one line, and one fun fact from on-this-day. Use only the facts given; skip any section whose data is missing.'

steps.run:
node -e 'const f = JSON.parse(process.env.FACTS); const links = f.news.slice(0, 3).map((n, i) => (i + 1) + ". " + n.title + "
   " + n.url); console.log(process.env.TEXT.trim() + (links.length ? "

🔗 Links
" + links.join("
") : ""))'

MSG=$(cat); if [ -n "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" ]; then openclaw message send --channel "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" --target "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_TARGET" --message "$MSG" >&2; fi; printf '%s\n' "$MSG"
